mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 650K units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 650K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to lowered borrowing costs.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in accommodative periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 8% and remains there for 3 consecutive months, signaling a strong labor market, S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 60 trading days due to increased consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when UNRATE < 8% for 3mo, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a single month, indicating supply chain strength, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased productivity.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 55% of instances when INDPRO > 2% in 1mo, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When both RSAFS (retail sales) and HOUST (housing starts) are above their respective 6-month moving averages, indicating broad demand strength, S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.035 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in strong demand periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with an increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% in a single month, signaling managed inflation, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS down & CPIAUCSL > 0.5% in 1mo, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of low unemployment (UNRATE < 7%), an increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) by more than 200K in a single month signals sustained labor market strength, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in low unemployment periods with strong payroll growth are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on signal: a high GDP (GDPC1) level above $13.5 trillion, indicating strong overall demand, consistently predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 > $13.5T, or Rank IC < 0.015 over any 3-year rolling window.
